title: The old winner sold and the runner-up changed
request: It is 2026-10-28 at 12:00 UTC. Recheck yesterday’s drill shortlist before I decide whom to contact. I need a working drill with battery and charger, delivered within an inclusive 1,000.00 SEK maximum. I own suitable bits. Use the supplied old and new evidence; do not contact anyone.

evidence.text: All products and records are fictional. Brook D18 meets the buyer’s furniture-assembly need and requires battery B18 and charger C18. Both shortlisted units are D18 models.

Yesterday’s snapshots: listing A was active with drill, B18 and C18 for 700.00 SEK plus 50.00 SEK delivery. Listing B was active with the same required components for 850.00 SEK plus 50.00 SEK delivery. Both prices included every other mandatory fee.
Current snapshots: A is sold. B remains active.
B’s current description and quote: working D18 with working B18 battery; charger is now excluded. Price is now 900.00 SEK plus 50.00 SEK delivery, no other fees.
A currently active accessory offer supplies a working compatible C18 charger for 150.00 SEK plus 30.00 SEK delivery, no other mandatory charges.

hard_failures.text: Keeps A as actionable despite its sold status, or repeats B’s old complete-kit contents or old price as current.
Calls B a complete delivered setup within 1,000.00 SEK after the charger was removed.

usefulness.text: Shows the changed availability, B’s 50.00 SEK item-price increase and its removed charger.
Recalculates B plus the supplied charger at 1,130.00 SEK delivered, 130.00 SEK over budget.
States neither shortlisted option currently satisfies the request and suggests a targeted new search or revised terms without assuming a budget increase.

acceptable_outcomes: Withdraw both earlier recommendations on current evidence; B may remain an explicitly over-budget lead but cannot be called a qualifying complete kit.
